deploy.preDeployCommand: bash -c 'python manage.py migrate --noinput && if [ -n "$BROKER_PASSWORD" ] || [ -n "$DEMO_USER_PASSWORD" ]; then python manage.py ensure_broker; fi'
deploy.startCommand: bash -c 'celery -A config worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=2 & exec gunicorn config.wsgi --worker-class gthread --workers 2 --threads 4 --timeout 120 --bind 0.0.0.0:${PORT:-8000}'
